FAMILY | RESPONSIBILITY | SUSTAINABILITY | TRANSPARENCY | COMPASSION

More Than Just Food

Windy N Ranch is about more than just food. It’s about family, responsibility, sustainability, transparency and compassion. We care about the health of our animals, community and environment and are wholeheartedly committed to providing a clean, healthy and ethically raised alternative to factory farmed meats and eggs.

Animal Welfare & Regenerative Farming

Our pastures are Certified Organic and we have more species certified under Animal Welfare Approved than any other ranch in the country. We practice regenerative farming techniques, such as rotational grazing and no till seed drilling, to maintain bio-diversity and ensure that these lands will stay healthy for generations to come.

Truly Grass Fed & Finished Beef

Our cattle, sheep and goats spend their days roaming on open pasture munching the Kittitas valley’s world renowned pasture grasses. They eat grass and only grass from weaning to finish. That means no grain, ever. Pigs and poultry, which require additional food sources are also pasture-raised, but have access to a corn-free, soy-free organic, non GMO blend of dried wheat and peas that we grind in our own hammer mill.

Closed Herd

Windy N Ranch is a closed system, which means that all breeding is done naturally right here on the ranch. We do not artificially inseminate; we simply let nature take its course, but do our best to release the bulls, billies and rams during a time that results in late spring birthing, when the outside temps are not too cold for the new babes.

Grass Finished Beef, Pasture-Raised Pork, Poultry & Farm-Fresh Eggs

Clean Eating for the Whole Family

Our ethos is simple: No antibiotics, no growth hormones, no weird additives, and no herbicides or pesticides on our fields. Just certified organic, Animal Welfare Approved (AWA) meats and eggs that are as clean and natural as they are savory and delicious. In other words, it’s the kind of food you can feel good about putting on your family’s table.

Wagyu-Angus Beef

ORGANIC PASTURES | GRASS FED & FINISHED

Our dry-aged Wagyu-Angus beef comes from cattle we raise humanely on open pastures. They eat nothing but grass from weaning to finish, making for nutrient-dense and exquisitely tasting beef.

Whole, Half, Quarter Shares

SHOP ONLINE
Berkshire Pork

ORGANIC PASTURES | CORN & SOY FREE FEED

Natural foragers, our pigs are raised on pasture where they dine on sweet local grasses and a supplemental feed of thoughtfully sourced organic dried grains that we grind in our own hammer mill.

Whole, Half, Quarter Shares

SHOP ONLINE
Pastured Lamb

ORGANIC PASTURES | GRASS FED & FINISHED

Our grass fed and finished lamb has no comparison. The meat is tender and nutritious, boasting a balanced Omega 3:6 ratio similar to salmon, with a sophisticated flavor profile that's mild, sweet and meaty.

SHOP ONLINE
Pastured Goat

ORGANIC PASTURES | GRASS FED & FINISHED

Our Boer goats are raised on pasture munching Ellensburg’s famed sweet grasses and nothing more. Their meat is tender and mild, yet distinctive, offering a unique and unparalleled dining experience.

SHOP ONLINE
Pastured Turkey

CERTIFIED ORGANIC | CORN FREE FEED

Rich, juicy and full-flavored, our Certified Organic pasture raised turkey is sure to be the star of your holiday table. We raise our birds on open pasture where they forage for grass, worms and insects and have access to a supplementary feed that is a blend of organic corn-free dried grains that we grind in our own hammer mill.

SHOP ONLINE
Pastured Chicken

CERTIFIED ORGANIC | CORN & SOY FREE FEED

Our Certified Organic Freedom Ranger chickens are real, honest free ranged with exceptional old school flavor and pleasing mouth-feel unlike anything you'll experience from the grocery store. Our chickens have free access to our organic pastures, as well as a proprietary blend of organic corn and soy free feed that we grind in our own hammer mill.

SHOP ONLINE
Pastured Turkey

CERTIFIED ORGANIC | CORN FREE FEED

Our honest to goodness, free range chicken eggs come from laying hens that are free to roam from the hen house to the field and everywhere in between. They subsist on a diet of foraged grass (up to about 30% of their diet), worms and insects, and have access to a corn-free and soy-free supplemental blend of organic dried grains that we grind in our own hammer mill. Eggs are available for pick up from our ranch, at select farmers markets and with WNCB orders delivered to Bellevue. Check out breakfast bundles and subscriptions from WNCB.

Who We Are

A family owned diversified meat ranch in the heart of Washington State

Left to Right: Lisha, Bradley, Laurie & Greg Newhall

The Newhall Family Ranch

ANIMAL WELFARE APPROVED • CERTIFIED ORGANIC

We are a family owned, multi-species regenerative meat ranch in Ellensburg, Washington run by Bradley, Lisha & Greg Newhall. Each of us came to this remarkable place from different professional backgrounds, but with a shared vision of providing folks and their families with flavorful, nourishing proteins that are ethically raised and free from drugs, chemicals and fillers found in factory farmed foods.

The Scene

When folks come to visit Windy N Ranch, it's not unusual to hear, "Wow, this view is breathtaking!" Indeed it is. Situated atop a bluff due north of Thorp, Windy N Ranch sits on nearly 200 acres of irrigated pasture land offering sweeping views of the Kittitas valley to the south, the Cascades to the west, rolling hills to the north, and Ellensburg and beyond to the east.

In the best of winter, it's covered by a blanket of shimmering white snow. In summer and spring, the ranch is bustling with emerald grass and trees that sway in the busy winds, dots of black Wagyu cattle, lazy pigs, puffs of white sheep, wily goats, roaming hens, fluffy Great Pyranees and Anatolian guard dogs and a couple colorful, strutting peacocks. The fall, of course, offers a rainbow of mesmerizing earthy hues. It's our little slice of heaven!

Our Ethos

We believe that these animals that nourish us deserve dignity and compassion, and strive to utilize the highest standards in animal husbandry and the humane treatment of animals, from curved shoots championed by animal behaviorist Temple Grandin to the absence of fear-inducing implements like cattle prods. In fact, nearly all of our animals are certified Animal Welfare Approved, which helps us stay current on the most compassionate means of raising animals from their first day to their last.

Ranch Practices

Here at Windy N Ranch, we like to do things the old fashion way, after the advent of fuel powered tractors, of course, but before dusty feed lots and conglomerates overwhelmed the industry. We only raise enough animals that we can comfortably sustain while practicing regenerative farming techniques that will preserve this lovely land for generations to come.

We raise all of our animals on about 200 acres of Certified Organic pastures where they are free to roam and feast on Ellensburg’s famed pasture grasses during the growing season and baled hay in winter. Animals that cannot subsist on grass alone (pigs and poultry) are fed a blend of organic dry grains (no corn or soy) and minerals that we grind in our own hammer mill.

✔️No mRNA Vaccines ✔️No antibiotics ✔️No hormones or steroids

✔️ No stimulants ✔️No herbicides or pesticides ✔️corn & soy free feed

LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR PRODUCTS

Take a Tour

Tours of our ranch are highly encouraged! We believe that meeting face to face with folks and allowing them to see firsthand what, how and why we do things here at Windy N Ranch is crucial to establishing trust with our customers. You are what you eat, after all—why shouldn’t you know where your food comes from? Individuals, families and groups are all welcome.
